sampled_open_items.title: Speed up Graph/MultiGraph copy() by not iterating undirected edges twice
sampled_open_items.body_excerpt:
heyhi

## What

`copy()` passes the full `self._adj` to `add_edges_from`. For an undirected graph that lists every edge from both endpoints, and `add_edges_from` already populates both directions, so the second pass just re-copies each edge's data and overwrites the entry it already created. This emits each undirected edge once instead.
